remarks: Welcome to this well-maintained 2-storey home in the desirable community of Crystallina Nera West! Offering approximately 1,368 sq. ft. of above-grade living space, this home features 3 bedrooms and 2.5 bathrooms, making it an excellent opportunity for families, first-time buyers or investors. The functional main floor offers comfortable living and dining spaces with a practical kitchen layout, while upstairs you'll find all three bedrooms, including the primary bedroom with ensuite. Enjoy the added comfort of central air conditioning, plus a fenced and landscaped yard and double detached garage. Conveniently located close to schools, shopping, public transportation and everyday amenities. A great opportunity to own in a growing north Edmonton community! (id:67522)
